title: Get approval to run a caravan park
what: Get the council's approval before operating a caravan park on a commercial basis. The council must be satisfied the operator is suitable and a manager lives on or near the site.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.quote: A person must not undertake the prescribed activity without a current approval granted by the local government.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.locator: sch 2 pt 2, definition of operation of caravan parks
sources.quote: operation of caravan parks means to operate, on a commercial basis, a place for parking and residing in caravans, including a place that provides also for complementary accommodation.

sources.title: Subordinate Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2024
sources.quote: the proposed operator is a suitable person to be operating a caravan park; and
